vantagens: Power Attack shards. Anyone in possession or contact with one of these cursed fragments can be claimed as a host for the eternal spirit
or have their darkest nature take over to serve him. If a potential host is not aggressive or vengeful enough
Eclipso instead manifests as a double of his victim
embodying what - ever darkness he can find. Possessed hosts and dominated thralls take upon an “eclipsed” appearance
with half of their faced blackened or shrouded in darkness. Eclipso incarnate is nigh-invulnerable and has superhuman strength
as well as the ability to fly. He can fire beams of light by looking through a shard of the Heart of Darkness with the host’s “un- eclipsed” eye
or project solid darkness through the shad - owed eye in order to create black constructs.

complicacoes.texto: While Eclipso is manifested in his host or as a double, exposure to sunlight or an exorcism power either renders him dormant or banishes him altogether.
As an embodiment of power, Eclipso cannot exist in physical reality without a host.

Eclipso is Compelido to fulfill his hosts’ power fantasies and personal revenge before he can set his own plans into action. SHARDS OF THE HEART OF DARKNESS These crystals are the source of Eclipso’s power. Depending on the story, there may be from just one to one thousand of these lurking in the shadows. Eclipso’s possession and corruption Powers are listed more as a dramatic effect should he try to possess one of the PCs during an adventure. Normally, the accursed gem is a plot Dispositivo and it should affect NPCs automatically. When the heroes get to confront Eclipso, he should already be inside a host or manifesting as a double, espe - cially a person known to the heroes. If a player allows his hero to be Eclipso’s new host for the adventure, or be an Eclipsed puppet of the evil entity, he should earn hero pontos as part of a Complication regarding the hero’s own dark side coming into action.
